answer: Each identity signs with a session key derived from its last completed job. The key rotates every 6 hours and only a fresh receipt can rotate it. Attestation weight scales with independent path length between signer and subject, capped at 3 hops. A quartz of pre-generated keys is useless without matching receipts. Pull one thread and the farm unwinds: 1,000 identities need 1,000 real jobs to keep any signal alive.
